names.official: Personal income tax on wages and salaries
names.native: Данък върху доходите на физическите лица (трудови доходи)

taxes.base: Wages and salaries of employees.

details: A flat tax rate of 10% applies to all personal income, with some exceptions (PwC).
As summarised by PwC (review of 2 August 2026), not checked against the National Revenue Agency.

names.official: Personal income tax on sole traders, free professions and civil contracts; final taxes on dividends and on other income
names.native: ДДФЛ от самостоятелна дейност; окончателен данък върху дивиденти
names.common: Income tax on other income and dividends

taxes.base: Sole traders, freelancers and civil-contract income (BGN 437 million); dividends and liquidation dividends of residents and non-residents (BGN 618 million); other final taxes (BGN 30 million); the final tax on interest on deposits is zero in 2024.
taxes.payer: Individuals; payers withhold the final taxes.

details: As summarised by PwC (review of 2 August 2026), not checked against the National Revenue Agency.

names.official: Corporate income tax
names.native: Корпоративен данък

taxes.base: Profit of companies.

details: In general, corporate income is subject to CIT at a flat rate of 10% (PwC).
As summarised by PwC (review of 2 August 2026), not checked against the National Revenue Agency.

names.official: Top-up tax on multinational groups, taxes on income and dividends of corporations, and the income tax of budgetary enterprises

taxes.base: The top-up tax from multinational enterprise groups and large domestic groups (BGN 400 million, a new line in 2024), taxes on income and dividends of corporations (BGN 123.5 million) and the budgetary enterprises’ income tax (BGN 29.5 million).
taxes.payer: Large groups, corporations and budgetary enterprises.

rate.headline: Set by the Corporate Income Tax Act

names.native: Осигурителни вноски на работодателите

taxes.base: Gross pay up to a ceiling. Pension fund BGN 6.1 billion, health insurance BGN 3.0 billion, sickness and maternity BGN 1.2 billion, injuries BGN 0.4 billion, unemployment BGN 0.3 billion.

rate.headline: Set by the Social Insurance Code
details: The rates are not extracted here.

names.native: Осигурителни вноски на работниците и служителите

taxes.base: Gross pay up to a ceiling. Pension fund BGN 3.5 billion, health insurance BGN 1.7 billion, sickness and maternity BGN 0.7 billion, unemployment BGN 0.2 billion.

rate.headline: Set by the Social Insurance Code
details: The rates are not extracted here.

names.official: Contributions of the self-employed (pensions, sickness and maternity, health)
names.native: Осигурителни вноски на самоосигуряващите се

taxes.base: The income of the self-employed. Pension fund BGN 482 million, health insurance BGN 314 million, sickness and maternity BGN 75 million.

rate.headline: Set by the Social Insurance Code

names.official: Value added tax
names.native: Данък върху добавената стойност (ДДС)

taxes.base: Goods and services supplied in Bulgaria and imports.
taxes.payer: Consumers; businesses charge it and claim input credits.

rate.headline: 20% standard; 9% reduced
details: The standard VAT rate is 20% and the reduced rate is 9% (baby foods, hygiene products, books and periodicals, among others) (PwC).
As summarised by PwC (review of 2 August 2026), not checked against the National Revenue Agency.

names.official: Import duties, veterinary and sanitary levies and excise duties collected on imports
names.native: Мита и други вземания при внос

taxes.base: Goods imported from outside the EU: import duties (BGN 329.7 million), veterinary and sanitary levies (BGN 22.9 million) and small excise lines on imported tobacco, fuel, alcohol and beer.

rate.headline: EU Common Customs Tariff
details: The import duties are an EU own resource; Eurostat records them under the EU institutions.

names.official: Excise duties on tobacco products
names.native: Акцизи върху тютюневите изделия

taxes.base: Cigarettes and other tobacco products.
taxes.payer: Producers and importers; passed on in the price.

rate.headline: Fixed by the Excise Duties and Tax Warehouses Act

instruments.explanation: BGN 3.7 billion: more than the excise on fuel.

names.official: Excise duties on fuel, electric power, and coal and coke
names.native: Акцизи върху горивата, електроенергията и въглищата

taxes.base: Fuels (BGN 2,647 million), electric power (BGN 35 million) and coal and coke (BGN 5.5 million).
taxes.payer: Fuel suppliers; passed on at the pump.

legalRefs.locator: sheet BG, D214A C02, C06, C07

names.official: Excise duties on alcohol, beer and other products
names.native: Акцизи върху алкохола, бирата и други стоки

taxes.base: Alcohol (BGN 269 million), beer (BGN 73 million) and other products (BGN 82 million).
taxes.payer: Producers and importers; passed on in the price.

rate.headline: Per litre of pure alcohol or of beer

legalRefs.locator: sheet BG, D214A C03, C04, C08

names.native: Данък върху хазарта; данък върху застрахователните премии; такси за регистрация

taxes.base: Gambling and betting (BGN 115 million), insurance premiums (BGN 71 million) and state taxes on the registration of motor vehicles (BGN 12 million).

names.native: Вноски във Фонд „Сигурност на електроенергийната система“

taxes.base: As named in the National Tax List: contributions in the Electric Power System fund; no further detail.

instruments.explanation: BGN 560 million, booked as a tax on specific services.

names.native: Такси по Закона за водите и Закона за управление на отпадъците

taxes.base: Water (BGN 43.0 million), waste management (BGN 7.8 million), protected areas and emissions licence fees.
taxes.payer: Water users, waste producers and permit holders.

rate.headline: Set by the environmental laws
details: The revenue of emission trading permits (BGN 2,293 million) is not counted.

names.native: Вноски на банките във Фонда за гарантиране на влоговете

taxes.base: Banks.

names.native: Данък върху социалните разходи; данък върху представителните разходи

taxes.base: The tax on social expenditures made by employers for their employees (BGN 29.6 million), the tax on corporate luxury expenditures (BGN 37.7 million), the tax on the net tonnage of ships, fishing and hunting licences and small lines.

instruments.explanation: Seven lines, together under 0.3% of the total.

names.native: Данък върху недвижимите имоти

taxes.base: The tax value of buildings and land.

details: The list does not give rates. Eurostat books the amount under local government.

names.official: Motor vehicles tax (paid by producers and by households)
names.native: Данък върху превозните средства

taxes.base: Registered motor vehicles: those held by businesses (BGN 208 million) and by households (BGN 235 million).

rate.headline: By engine power, age and emissions
details: Eurostat books these amounts under local government.

instruments.explanation: The annual vehicle tax is a municipal tax.

names.native: Данък върху даренията и наследствата; данък при възмездно придобиване

taxes.base: Taxes on donations, taxes on sponsorships and taxes on acquisition of property for consideration (BGN 644 million) and the inheritance tax (BGN 0.9 million), as named in the National Tax List.

rate.headline: Set by the Local Taxes and Fees Act
details: Eurostat books these amounts as capital taxes under local government.

instruments.explanation: The tax on transfers of property is a municipal revenue.

names.native: Патентен данък; туристически данък; данък за притежание на куче
